name: repeat-select
title: Repeat select
description: Repeat options worked out from the start date (Every week on Tuesday, Every month on the 27th) that return a ready-to-use RRULE string.
docs: start is the first day, as an ISO date; the weekday, the day of the month and the month in the labels come from it, written by Intl in the locale you pass. value is the recurrence rule as a calendar file writes it ("RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU"), or null for no repeat; onValueChange reports the new rule. The choices are Does not repeat, Every day, Every week on Tuesday, Every month on the 27th (in the last seven days of a month it reads "on the last Tuesday" and becomes BYDAY=-1TU), Every year on 27 October and Every weekday (Monday to Friday); include picks which of them to offer, and they always keep that order. When start changes, the rule moves with it: a weekly rule on Tuesday becomes one on Thursday, the labels change together with it, onValueChange is called with the new rule and the change is announced. A rule that none of the choices describes (every other week, a count, an end date) shows as Custom with the rule under it; onCustom adds a Custom choice that hands the current rule to your own editor. Rules are read in any equivalent spelling, so FREQ=WEEKLY on a Tuesday is the weekly choice. labels replaces every sentence, for another language, and the helpers in repeat-select/rules.ts (ruleFor, kindOf) work without the component. name sends the rule with a plain form.
